headline: Mitsotakis: Increase in heating allowance and extension of diesel subsidy
summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis announced an increase in the heating allowance and an extension of the diesel subsidy. He also addressed cost-of-living measures and energy interventions.
why: Energy subsidies and household allowances are fiscal measures that affect government spending and consumer costs. They are often used to cushion households against energy price increases.
